items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: But then, when he heard our trio, he decided that he would like the same thing. So he hired Bill and I away from Gerry, and that was the start of a new Tatum trio. And we did many albums with that group, the albums with different people.

ctx.x: You mean he never had before that?

Well, he had worked with a bass and guitar, Slam Stewart and Tiny Grimes before. But for some reason, he gave that trio up and just did a single for a while. But then, when he heard our trio, he decided that he would like the same thing. So he hired Bill and I away from Gerry, and that was the start of a new Tatum trio. And we did many albums with that group, the albums with different people. Naturally, the Tatum albums, but we also recorded with Ben Webster, Buddy De Franco, Sweets Edison and maybe a few other…
